steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Point: You MUST discuss BOTH the extract AND the whole play. Ignoring either will cost you marks. | The Bridge Method: After analysing the extract, add a paragraph that connects to the wider play. Use phrases like: "This moment echoes..." "Earlier in the play..." "This contrasts with..." "Later, we see..." | Extract Analysis Strategy: Spend 5 minutes reading and annotating before writing. Identify 3-4 key quotations to analyse in depth. Roughly 2/3 of your essay should analyse the extract; 1/3 should link to the whole play. Use the "Bridge Method": after analysing a quotation, bridge to the wider play with phrases like "This moment echoes..." or "Later, we see..."

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: What should you look for in a close reading of an extract? | How do you embed a quotation effectively? | What's the difference between extract analysis and whole-play linking?
